h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.hypothesis: R0's dots that sit in the near-catalogue collar carry less credit than the metric's break-even, so deleting them raises DTI even though some are close to known traces.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.mechanism: Binary-dot algebra (vendor/gems57/metric.py): DTI = T/(0.2*(T+n-M)+0.8|G|). Removing one dot lowers the denominator by exactly 0.2 regardless of its credit, so a removal gains iff that dot's realised credit to unseen truth is below 0.2*DTI = 0.0556 at DTI 0.2778. The removed set is concentrated in the collar, which is the region where the 0.2708->0.2778 prune paid.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.ranking_basis: 0.6*clip(d_catalogue_px/50) + 0.4*uniform(seed88). This is NOT the parent's model ranking: R0's score field is not stored anywhere (every H33-lineage raster is binary). 40% of the score is uniform noise and 20% of parent dots saturate the distance term at 1.0.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.what_the_ranking_actually_does: 89.4% of the 3,765 dropped dots lie within 10 px of the mapped catalogue vs a 30.2% baseline (2.96x); 53.5% within 5 px vs 15.0% (3.58x). Mean distance 5.69 px dropped vs 31.59 px kept. This is a collar extension (PRUNE), not a low-prior prune. Measured in registry/mass_ranking_audit.json.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan benches (1212/1298/1334 m) and GeoDAWN E-W flight-line corrugation produce subparallel lineaments that pass gravity/RTP edge filters but are not faults; the collar also contains genuine new faults, and organiser thread 11536 says new-fault truth may lie within 300 m of known traces, so a collar deletion can remove true positives.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.predicted_sign_size: +0.004 (MODEL), range [-0.006, +0.014]. Conditional on mean removed-dot credit: +0.012 at credit 0, +0.006 at half the break-even, 0.0 at credit 0.0556, -0.203 in the worst case. Sign is driven by how much unseen truth sits in the 2-10 px collar, which is not observable.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.falsifier: A live delta at or below -0.010 falsifies it: the collar contains net true positives, and the 0.2708->0.2778 prune gain was itself inside the noise floor (0.007 < 0.01). A live delta at or above +0.010 confirms the collar is mostly false positive mass and should be pushed further as a PRUNE experiment.

h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.hypothesis: None that the evidence supports. This variant was built to test whether R0 under-calls high-prior tip/relay zones, but the dots actually added are not in high-prior zones.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.mechanism: Same algebra. Adding one dot raises the denominator by exactly 0.2 and the numerator by its credit, so an addition pays iff credit > 0.0556. That corresponds to unseen truth within 2.83 px of the added dot.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.ranking_basis: 0.6*clip(d_catalogue_px/50) + 0.4*uniform(seed90) over the allowed-2px pool. Because the distance term saturates at 50 px, the added set is dominated by far-from-catalogue random draws, not by a tip/relay score.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.what_the_ranking_actually_does: The 3,765 added dots have mean catalogue distance 74.2 px, mean nearest-parent-dot distance 20.6 px, 85.2% isolated beyond the 3 px kernel, and mean independent prior 0.119 vs 0.400 for the parent. They are the lowest-prior, most isolated positions available in the pool. Measured in registry/mass_ranking_audit.json.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.non_fault_mimic: Open basin floor and alluvial aprons: isolated lineaments there are exactly where weak surface expression generates false positives. The variant places mass where no independent model nor any coherent structure supports it.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.predicted_sign_size: -0.010 (MODEL), range [-0.014, +0.002]. At zero mean credit the algebra gives -0.011; the bar of 0.0556 (truth within 2.83 px) is not plausibly met at 85% of these locations.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.falsifier: A live delta at or above +0.010 would falsify the whole picture and mean R0 systematically misses isolated structures that the kernel still credits - in which case the SPACING axis, not MASS, owns the next three slots.

h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.hypothesis: A deeper collar cut than m10minus, to bound how much near-catalogue mass is false positive.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.mechanism: As m10minus: removal lowers the denominator by exactly 0.2 per dot and gains iff the dot's credit is below 0.2*DTI = 0.0556.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.ranking_basis: 0.6*clip(d_catalogue_px/50) + 0.4*uniform(seed88), the same score as m10minus, cut at 20% instead of 10%.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.what_the_ranking_actually_does: 7,531 dots dropped, 99.3% within 20 px of the catalogue and 75.4% within 10 px (2.50x enrichment). Mean distance 7.31 px dropped vs 34.42 px kept. Because it is the same ranking cut deeper, m10minus is a strict superset relationship: this file varies mass AND collar together.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.non_fault_mimic: As m10minus, plus loss of genuine near-trace new faults, which organiser thread 11536 explicitly allows.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.predicted_sign_size: +0.001 (MODEL), range [-0.015, +0.017]. Conditional on mean removed-dot credit: +0.025 at credit 0, +0.0125 at half the break-even, 0.0 at 0.0556, -0.425 in the worst case. Wider than m10minus because 7,531 removals amplify either sign.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.falsifier: Grade it only against m10minus. If both are submitted and the ordering is not monotone (deeper cut worse than shallower), the collar-credit model is wrong and collar position is not what drives the effect.

h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.hypothesis: At a fixed dot count, raising local dot density on the parent's most confident km-scale clusters raises the metric more than the relocation costs, because the metric's false-positive term is sum_x p(x)(1 - max_g k): a dot welded next to an already-covering dot pays almost no penalty (0.2(1 - k) ~ 0.07 at 1 px) while a dot in an empty km block pays the full 0.2. Mass moved out of the coldest blocks therefore relieves denominator weight that the parent was still paying.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.mechanism: DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(n - M) + 0.8|G|) with n fixed at 37654. Each move changes the denominator by 0.2(t_add - t_rm + m_rm - m_add). Donors are drawn from the coldest 1 km blocks (mean block prior 0.75 dots/km2) where m_rm ~ 0; receivers land in blocks with mean prior 2.54 dots/km2 at 1.04 px from a surviving host, so m_add is inherited from the host's proximity to truth. No new pixels enter the catalogue collar and no block is emptied.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan benches and GeoDAWN E-W flight-line corrugation both survive edge filters and pack into km-scale bands; welding dots onto them raises M only if the host is actually near truth, so a mimic shows up as a null (m_add ~ 0), not a false gain. Conversely, alluvial geothermal outflow along range fronts forms km-scale clusters with no fault slip, which would produce a real m_add but nothing in T.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.predicted_sign_size: MODEL +0.011 live, scenario range [-0.002, +0.030]. Point scenario: m_add 0.30, t_rm 0.02, m_rm 0.02, t_add = 0.2 m_add, calibrated on the two CLAIM pairs (0.2778 / 0.2600). The sign is not guaranteed: at m_add <= 0.15 and t_rm >= 0.02 the recall lost from the donors dominates.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.confounder: CV excursion. Under every estimator tried, R0 sits at 0.62 (raw 1 km counts, occupied blocks) / 0.48 (5 km-smoothed density); these variants push it to 1.02-1.36 / 0.67-1.07, far outside the 0.51-0.59 band the brief quotes for the best files. If that band is causal and not an artefact of the estimator, the live change should be negative even though the algebra predicts positive. That is the cleanest way to falsify the folklore.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.falsifier: Live change <= -0.010: concentration past the parent costs real recall, the cold-tail donors were catching isolated blind faults, and the axis is closed. Live change in (-0.010, +0.010): the metric's redundancy credit is too small to matter at 10-20 % and the axis is closed as sub-noise at this dose. Live change >= +0.010 with the 20 % move > 10 % move: mechanism confirmed, scale the dose and combine with the best MASS setting next session.
